review_candidates.title: People Operations Specialist
review_candidates.description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About The Role We're looking for a People Operations Specialist to help keep day-to-day People operations reliable, responsive and well organised as UFORCE grows. You'll support employees across the employee lifecycle by answering everyday questions, coordinating onboarding, handling employment verifications and background checks, and keeping employee records and documentation accurate and up to date. You won't be expected to know every process on day one. Working with the People Operations Lead, you'll learn our systems and workflows, take ownership of agreed routine tasks and know when to ask for guidance. Alongside daily operations, you'll contribute to projects that improve the employee experience and make our processes work better. This is an early-career role for someone with 2–3 years of HR or Talent experience who is proactive, detail-oriented and ready to build broader People Operations expertise. The role is fully remote, based in Ukraine or the EU. You'll report to the People Operations Lead. What you'll do Be a day-to-day point of contact for employee People-related questions — providing clear, helpful responses, tracking requests and escalating unfamiliar or sensitive matters. Coordinate onboarding with Talent, hiring managers, IT and other partners, keeping checklists and handoffs on track so new hires are ready for day one. Handle employment verification requests using established procedures, with careful attention to accuracy and confidentiality. Coordinate background checks, administer the provider's platform and follow up on outstanding cases, escalating findings to authorised decision-makers. Maintain employee records in our HR systems, checking data, updating information and keeping documentation organised. Prepare and maintain routine employee documentation under the People Operations Lead's guidance. Keep trackers and process guides current, follow up on open tasks and flag delays or gaps before they become bigger issues. Contribute to employee-lifecycle projects by helping improve workflows, refreshing documentation, and delivering agreed project tasks. Work closely with the People and Talent teams and cross-functional partners to keep everyday operations moving. Required Skills 2–3 years of experience in HR and/or Talent, with hands-on involvement in coordination, employee or candidate support, and administrative processes. Strong organisation and attention to detail: you can manage competing tasks, maintain clear trackers and check records and documents carefully. A proactive approach to work: anticipate next steps, follow up without repeated reminders and flag issues early. Clear, empathetic communication and a service mindset: keep people informed and handle questions thoughtfully. A willingness to learn unfamiliar systems and processes, ask thoughtful questions and apply feedback. Good judgment around confidential information and knowing when to involve your manager rather than guess. Confidence using spreadsheets and digital tools, with the ability to learn HR systems. Nice to have Experience in a startup or fast-growing company. Exposure to onboarding coordination, HRIS/ATS administration, employment verifications or background-check platforms. Experience supporting distributed or international teams. Some working-hours overlap with US Eastern Time. The nature of combat has changed. Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability. And UFORCE is ready. Are You?

review_candidates.title: Manager Payroll Operations I
review_candidates.description: Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region. Our award-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce. Our brand promise - Makes Work Life Better™- Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally. About The Opportunity The Manager, Payroll Operations I leads a high-volume Wage Garnishment Operations team. The role provides day-to-day leadership for Wage Attachment Specialists and Managed Operations Specialists who process child support orders, tax levies, creditor garnishments, and other legally mandated deductions. This leader ensures wage garnishment activity is accurate, timely, and compliant with applicable federal, state, provincial, and client requirements. The role is accountable for team performance, operational results, employee development, quality, productivity, client service, and continuous improvement across a globally distributed operation supporting U.S. and Canadian payroll functions. What you will do Lead, coach, and develop Wage Attachment Specialists and Managed Operations Specialists through regular one-on-one meetings, performance conversations, documentation, and career development planning. Set clear expectations and foster a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous learning, and professional growth. Provide leadership and wage garnishment expertise so the team has the tools, training, and support required to succeed. Oversee daily operations across global locations to ensure orders are received, reviewed, entered, maintained, and processed accurately, on time, and in compliance with requirements. Manage schedules, staffing, workloads, and coverage to meet operational demand and service-level commitments. Monitor productivity, accuracy, quality, audit results, turnaround times, aging work, and other operational metrics; identify trends and implement corrective actions. Maintain effective quality controls that reduce errors and defects while meeting client requirements, company policies, regulations, and service-level agreements. Partner with clients, payroll teams, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to resolve complex issues and provide a seamless client experience. Document, escalate, and follow through on operational and client issues with appropriate urgency. Lead team meetings that reinforce quality, compliance, operational priorities, company initiatives, and employee participation. Collaborate with peer leaders to keep processes aligned, efficient, and scalable across the department. Identify process-improvement opportunities and present data-informed recommendations to leadership. Lead effectively through ongoing change in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Skills And Experience We Value Three or more years of people leadership experience in high-volume wage garnishment, payroll, benefits, or a related operations environment. Direct experience managing or supporting a wage garnishment team is strongly preferred. Knowledge of wage garnishment processes, order types, compliance requirements, and payroll deductions. Knowledge of North American payroll practices; experience with U.S. and Canadian payroll is preferred. Demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing employees in a performance-driven environment. Ability to partner effectively across functions and deliver a seamless experience in a matrixed organization. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with leaders, internal partners, clients, and team members. Strong problem-solving, planning, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to align work to business goals. Experience managing staffing, schedules, quality, productivity, service-level performance, and operational risk. Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience. Industry-related certification is an asset. Experience in an outsourcing or consulting environment is preferred. Adaptability, flexibility, and the ability to manage change with composure. What will help you stand out Experience leading and coaching a high-volume wage garnishment team across end-to-end processing, quality, compliance, and client service. Strong working knowledge of child support orders, tax levies, creditor garnishments, and other involuntary deductions. Experience managing and coaching Wage Attachment Specialists or Managed Operations Specialists. Working knowledge of payroll, benefits, and workforce management functions. Experience translating business priorities into clear team actions and managing broad day-to-day operations in a high-volume environment. A track record of using metrics to improve quality and delivering measurable process improvements. Sound judgment in resolving complex operational or client issues with urgency. Ability to learn and use tools that support efficient processes and effective people leadership. Multinational payroll experience, particularly in the U.S. and Canada. Experience managing, directing, or collaborating with offshore teams that provide daily operational support and subject matter expertise. What’s In It For You Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions. Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits. With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself. Artificial intelligence may be used in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. Fraudulent Recruiting Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be-aware-of-recruiting-fraud Dayforce actively monitors all job applications to ensure authenticity. Submissions determined to be fraudulent or misleading will be declined from the recruitment process

You will manage the delivery of employee Human Resource (HR) services and lead service improvement projects with a digitalisation focus to enhance HR administrative services for staff across multiple locations. What You Will Be Working On Manage the delivery of integrated employee HR services, including comprehensive onboarding processes across different MINDEF office locations Lead and implement service improvement projects with a strong focus on digitalisation to enhance HR administrative services Manage processes and system workflows to optimise service delivery efficiency Drive service journey designs to improve business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as case resolution times and customer satisfaction scores Challenge(s) Managing complex service delivery across multiple MINDEF office locations while maintaining consistent service quality and standards Balancing digitalisation initiatives with existing operational requirements Ensuring smooth transitions during system implementations What We Are Looking For Education in Human Resource, Business Administration, or a related discipline At least 3 years of relevant work experience in a service-related field, with demonstrated experience in HR operations or service delivery is preferred Experience in project management is advantageous Strong service orientation with a keen interest in innovation and digitalisation Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (Applicants with no experience may apply.)
